name: Monzo Glance
author: silentjay
description: Monzo in your bar: this month's spending pace against your usual month, as a pound sign. Read-only, unofficial. A UK (GBP) fork of Pupa.

barWidget.description: This month's spending pace against your usual month, as a pound sign. Hover for the card, click for Monzo. Read-only; unofficial.

schema.label: Engine command
schema.description: The command run on every tick. Leave blank to use the engine shipped with the plugin. Its last stdout line is the whole display: the glyph, the face state and every string on the card.

schema.label: Tick (seconds)
schema.description: How often the engine is run. It reads its cache; it asks Monzo at most once an hour whatever this says.

schema.label: Hover
schema.description: What a hover over the pound sign shows: the card, or the same strings as a plain text tooltip.

schema.label: Tint the pound sign by pace
schema.description: Green at or under a usual month, amber ahead of it. Off paints it in the bar's own color; stale and broken look the same either way.
